inspectedText: The charred parchment fragmented on touch. Micro-CT supplied a volume; segmentation located surfaces, texturing sampled intensities, and flattening formed readable images. Ink was denser in the scan; metal content was inferred, not chemically established. Recovered Hebrew columns were identified as Leviticus. The object was not physically unrolled. Transformation provenance enables checking extracted text against scan voxels. Transport and handling still carry risk. Dating methods differ; no exact age used.
